title: Kill the N+1 on the post list with with()
summary: Eager load the author instead of fetching it per row, and count comments with withCount.

files.content:
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Post;

class PostController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $posts = Post::latest()->paginate(20);

        return view('posts.index', ['posts' => $posts]);
    }
}

turns.user: post list is slow. debugbar says 22 queries for one page. PostController@index

assistant.body: Classic N+1! Every $post->user->name in the view fetches its author one row at a time. Here's the fix: with('user') loads every author up front, so a page costs three queries, the count, the posts and the authors.

turns.user: oh also want the comment count on each row. without adding more queries pls

assistant.body: withCount('comments') puts the count in the same SELECT as a subquery and gives each post a comments_count attribute. No comment rows are loaded at all, only the number.
